notes: NEWS FROM HARMONY CREEK · the zine's LETTERS COLUMN, hosted on F.T.'s board (Maya is his correspondent; the paper copies go through the Kwik Stop envelope). The PLANNED COMMUNITY register per _PSYCHEDELIC_DESIGN_BIBLE.md — zines, the meta pause, the pressure curve as tempo: letters lengthen through W6, go terse in the W13-14 storm window, ease by W16. Every reader who writes becomes the issue. M.D. never signs a name. Authored 2026-09-07 (game grammar row 2).

op.body:
to the editor of NEWS FROM HARMONY CREEK.

I am told the walk in issue #6 is mine. I did not give permission for the walk to be drawn. I am not angry. I would like it noted that the walk is shorter now than it was drawn. My knee.

The cookies are not a chapter. They are cookies.

-- lot 14

replies.body:
printed with permission that was not asked for, which is the only kind a zine gets.

the walk is redrawn for the reprint. shorter. the knee is in it now.

the wax paper is noted for the record. some chapters get themselves told by the wrapping. -- m.d.

threads.subject: re: issue #11, the back cooler (a correction)

op.body:
correction for the letters page. panel 5 did not happen. I was eating a hot pocket. I did not look up. I never look up at that guy.

the rest is fine. the rest is exactly what I wrote. -- s.m. (sam, hello)

replies.body:
the strip does not say you looked up. the strip says the glass had you looking up. those are different sentences and the second one is the one I drew.

correction printed anyway. the fund thanks you for the dollar. -- m.d.
For the record from the sysop's chair: the glass is usually right. -- F.

op.body:
your grandmother's vacuum is on my tape. track 3, under the hum. four on, four off. I did not put it there. I recorded the hum off the power lines behind lot 47 in March and the vacuum is in it.

bring the zine. I will show you. bring a pencil, my copier is broken. -- lot 47

replies.body:
issue #15 was not about the vacuum. it was about my grandmother.

I will bring a pencil. -- m.d.

op.body:
a zine with a letters column is a newspaper. a newspaper is what they read at the pool.

that said. the van was at 892 twice this week. tuesday and thursday. eleven badge clips on the passenger seat, I counted from the sidewalk. the pace is picking up out there and nobody is drawing it but you, so. draw it.

-- PHASE III (issue 2 is late, do not ask)

replies.body:
a letters column is where the readers become the issue. that is not a newspaper. that is the point.

892 is drawn. it has been drawn for a year. -- m.d.

threads.subject: a note from the NexCorp Voice

op.body:
A courteous note, unsigned, on behalf of a newsletter you do not read.

NexCorp Residential Solutions would prefer that its service vehicles not be photographed on residential streets. The vehicles are not the story. The community is the story. We are all, in the end, the community.

Thank you for your understanding.

replies.body:
we don't photograph. we draw.

a drawing is not a picture of the van. it is a picture of the looking. you cannot ask us to stop looking; it is the one thing the HOA does not have a form for. -- m.d.
Sysop's note: the Voice is welcome here. Everyone dials the same number in the end. -- F.

op.body:
M.D. -- the book stops here for a while. Part one ends, the seam opens, people put it down and go to the pool and come back in a few weeks or don't.

We don't stop. That's the whole point of a board and the whole point of a zine. Print what you have. Number it. The numbers are what carry across a pause.

-- F., who is also awake at 2:33

replies.body:
issue #20 is the pause. eight blank pages, stapled, quarter-letter. one dollar. the fund does not take pauses either.

I have twenty-three issues in me. I have counted. -- m.d.

op.body:
storm on the coast. power at the kwik stop went twice. the back cooler is warm. the guy still stood in front of it.

that's the letter. -- s.m.

the grey sedan came back. tuesday. three minutes, like before. she did not get out. I was on my walk. the short one.

I am telling the zine because the zine is the only one keeping the list. -- lot 14

replies.body:
recorded for the record. the unidentified visitor, second appearance, tuesday, three minutes. still not matched to any known party.

thank you for walking. -- m.d.

op.body:
a dollar is taped to this letter. I know you cannot see it on a board. it is taped to the paper copy in the envelope at the kwik stop.

what is the fund for. everyone asks. nobody asks you. -- a frog (one of the ninety-seven)

replies.body:
the fund is for the next issue.

it has always been for the next issue. that is what a fund is. -- m.d.
